_about: Blocking transpiler findings that are known, reviewed and intended. rulebook_to_web4.py exits 1 on any blocking finding not listed here, and aic_demo.py refuses to activate law on such a run. Each entry names the finding kind, the norm it is about, and why it stands.

exceptions.reason: operating agreement clause 2.3 (r-23) is the demo's intentional exclusion: the draft's §8008 contradicts it, so it never compiles. Beat 3 shows the refusal. If the citation were overruled it would still be rejected as ChildOverrideWidensParent, which is NOT allowlisted.
